_comment: Original AstroVerse text. Sign-based daily/weekly horoscope (solar houses). Tone and guardrails: docs/INTERPRETATION.md. Review status: DRAFT until the owner approves.

moonHouse.1: The Moon is in your sign today, so your feelings sit close to the surface. Do one thing that is just for you.
moonHouse.2: Today the Moon turns your attention to what you value and what helps you feel secure. A simple comfort can steady you.
moonHouse.3: The Moon favors short chats, messages and errands today. Reach out to a sibling, neighbor or friend you have been meaning to text.
moonHouse.4: Home and family are on your mind today. Time in a cozy space, or with the people you grew up with, can recharge you.
moonHouse.5: The Moon brings a lighter, playful mood today. Make room for fun, a hobby or something creative.
moonHouse.6: A good day for routines and getting things done. Tidy one small corner of your work or your daily habits.
moonHouse.7: Today the focus is on the people close to you. Listening well may matter more than being right.
moonHouse.8: Feelings may run deeper today. An honest talk with someone you trust can bring you closer.
moonHouse.9: Your mind wants something new today. Read, learn, plan a trip, or try a different point of view.
moonHouse.10: Work and your goals come into focus today. Show what you can do, and be proud of steady progress.
moonHouse.11: Friends and groups can lift you up today. Reach out, join in, or share a hope you have been keeping to yourself.
moonHouse.12: The Moon asks you to slow down today. Rest, quiet time or journaling can help you reset.

phase.new: New Moon: a quiet time to set one small, clear intention.
phase.waxing-crescent: The Moon is growing: take the first small step on something you want to build.
phase.first-quarter: First Quarter Moon: if something feels stuck, a decision or a small push can help.
phase.waxing-gibbous: The Moon is almost full: keep refining what you have started.
phase.full: Full Moon: feelings can run high. Notice what has grown, and what you are ready to let go.
phase.waning-gibbous: After the Full Moon: a good time to share what you have learned and to say thank you.
phase.last-quarter: Last Quarter Moon: clear out what you no longer need, from old messages to old habits.
phase.waning-crescent: The Moon is fading: rest, reflect and get ready for a fresh start.

moonChange: Around {time}, the Moon moves into your {n} house and the mood shifts toward {topic}.

weekly.Sun: The Sun lights up your {n} house this week, so {topic} is where your energy goes.
weekly.Mercury: Mercury in your {n} house makes this a good week to think, talk and plan around {topic}.
weekly.Venus: Venus in your {n} house brings warmth to {topic}. Small kind gestures go a long way.
weekly.Mars: Mars in your {n} house gives you drive around {topic}. Put it into steady action rather than arguments.
weekly.retrograde: {body} is retrograde in your {n} house: a time to review and redo around {topic}, rather than rush. Double-check plans and messages.
weekly.newMoon: New Moon in your {n} house on {day}: a good moment to set a fresh intention about {topic}.
weekly.fullMoon: Full Moon in your {n} house on {day}: things around {topic} may come to a head. Notice what is ready to be finished or let go.
